venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: o Yes. For shows with a general admission floor, we have a designated area for patrons with special needs and one companion. A specific ticket is not required to access this area. For reserved seated shows, guests with ADA needs can purchase tickets online or at the box office. The designated seats will show online with the ADA symbol.
